Def.label: add to group
Def.description: Adds the pawn to a manually created Colony Groups group without duplicates. The group's enabled policies are applied normally.

Def.label: delete from groups
Def.description: Removes only this pawn from all manually created pawn groups, including remembered membership. Keeps the groups, their other members, and automatic colony/caravan groups. Disables automatic deletion of affected empty groups.
